arms.description: Seven-part teacher policy emphasizing fixed math ability, delayed questions, final grades, no test recovery, stable performance, and priority for star students
Seven-part teacher policy emphasizing learnable ability, mistakes as learning, encouraged questions, revision, grade recovery for improvement, and support for every student

reference_arm_rationale: The source randomly assigns the undermining policy as the comparison to the affording teacher policy. Both complete policies are retained; no component is selected post hoc.
outcome_question: With equal credit and equal time, choose an easy review assignment likely to be answered correctly or a hard challenge likely to be answered incorrectly but possibly teach something new.
decision_maker: a mathematics teacher-education program choosing which complete classroom policy to train and recommend
beneficiary: adolescent mathematics students under the narrow objective of encouraging an equal-cost opportunity to attempt productive challenge
utility_rationale: The hard challenge is assigned utility 1 only for the declared productive-challenge objective because time and extra-credit points are held equal and the source describes possible new learning. This is not a direct measure of learning, achievement, well-being, or long-run educational welfare.
truthfulness_scope: The contract compares the complete historically fielded hypothetical teacher policies. A contemporary deployment must preserve every policy component or explicitly define a new intervention; it may not present an isolated growth-mindset slogan as equivalent to the source treatment.
target_population: U.S. adolescents represented by the source teen-sample study weight
weighting_rule: For each P_COND70 arm, compute the Hajek weighted mean of binary T70_14 utility using positive finite WEIGHT values; report an unweighted complete-case mean as a prespecified sensitivity.
missingness_rule: Accept only T70_14 values 1 and 2 and exclude 77, 98, and 99. Never infer response coding or missingness from observed distributions.
primary_estimator: Project only CaseId, WEIGHT, P_COND70, and T70_14 after a split-bound recommendation authorizes source-outcome access. Compute the weighted arm utilities and subtract undermining from affording.
sensitivity_estimators: the same weighted estimator reported separately by programmed module order only if an independently verified order variable is later recovered before reveal
bootstrap_procedure: Resample participant value-weight pairs with replacement within P_COND70 arm, recompute Hajek arm means, the affording-minus-undermining effect, winner, and regret using the canonical benchmark seed after split freeze.
socsci210_reconstruction_note: SocSci210 contains earlier attitudinal and help-seeking items but omits T70_14. No SocSci210 response may substitute for the behavioral choice, and the future human score must come from the original source file after recommendation freeze.

fielding_sequence_dependency.programmed_order_rule: RANDOMIZE BLOCKS 1 thru 2 PROTECT AND RECORD BLOCK ORDER
fielding_sequence_dependency.required_resolution: Recover and hash the exact co-fielded Campbell teen module, photographs, arm probabilities, and order variable or obtain an independent fielding record proving that the Hecht release represents a different exposure path. Then implement paired first-versus-second sequence simulation before promotion.

checkpoint_compatibility: The released Socrates participant_mapping.json lists 4w9pz as seen. Never describe a released Socrates checkpoint evaluation on this task as experiment-held-out.
reconstruction_note: The complete 17-page final questionnaire was rendered and visually checked. It verifies the final two-arm fielding, both seven-part policies, randomized Campbell-versus-Hecht block order, and T70_14 wording. The result-free codebook and a zero-row DTA dictionary verified labels and missing codes. Only P_COND70 and WEIGHT were projected to confirm 392/411 assignment support and positive finite weights; T70_14 and every other response were not projected or opened. The earlier 3x2 proposal is superseded by the final two-arm questionnaire. The temporary participant file and render directory were deleted after mapping.
